releasePairs.english: Open the official forecast documentation, open-data description and terms from Indonesia’s research-queue card. Source links do not enable a forecast feed or local crop advice.
releasePairs.zu: Vula imibhalo esemthethweni yesibikezelo, incazelo yedatha evulekile nemigomo ekhadini locwaningo lase-Indonesia. Izixhumanisi zemithombo azivuli idatha yesibikezelo noma izeluleko zezitshalo zendawo.
releasePairs.st: Bula ditokomane tsa semmuso tsa ponelopele, tlhaloso ya data e bulehileng le dipehelo kareteng ya Indonesia lenaneng la dipatlisiso. Dihokelo tsa mehlodi ha di bulele data ya ponelopele kapa keletso ya dijalo ya lehae.
releasePairs.ve: Vulani maḓokumente a tshiofisi a mavhonele a mutsho, ṱhaluso ya data yo vuleaho na milayo kha garata ya Indonesia ya ṱoḓisiso. Zwikhokanyi zwa zwiko a zwi vulisi data ya mavhonele a mutsho kana nyeletshedzo ya zwimela ya henefho.
releasePairs.ts: Pfula matsalwa ya ximfumo ya vuprofeta bya maxelo, nhlamuselo ya data leyi pfulekeke ni swipimelo eka khadi ra Indonesia ra ndzavisiso. Swihlanganisi swa swihlovo a swi pfuri data ya vuprofeta bya maxelo kumbe switsundzuxo swa swibyariwa swa ndhawu.
